disable.rationale: Disables extensions by changing configuration state (reversible via enable).

enable.rationale: Enables extensions by changing configuration state (reversible via disable).

install.rationale: Installs extensions, modifying system state but in an expected, reversible way.

list.rationale: Lists installed or available extensions without modifying state.

search.rationale: Searches for extensions in a repository without making changes.

show.rationale: Displays detailed information about specific extensions.

uninstall.rationale: Removes specific extensions; deletion is reversible via reinstall.

update.rationale: Updates extension versions; includes --dry-run to preview changes safely.
